description: Guided opt-out fer NumberGuru, which lists folk by phone number. One opt-out covers every saved phone number.
instructions: Search https://www.numberguru.com/ fer each of these numbers: {all_phones}. On any page that shows ye, use the "Remove This Listing" or "Opt Out" link an' give {contact_email} as yer email. Then smash "I've done this".
